data_rule: HMM-use runs only;CAL Phase47-C only OURS-DETOUR+HMM,EVAL Phase57 only MIN/MIN+G18;all methods in remaining specified phases;EVAL seeds227,228;CAL/EVAL dirs and seeds disjoint

obs.emission: product across ALL logged window candidate distances,computed in log space
obs.range: calibration min/max floor(distance/.5) plus fixed underflow and overflow bins;never evaluation values

sign.tangent: unit central adjacent-node difference;one-sided ends;zero vector uses nearest nonzero oriented adjacent edge
sign.progress: current minus previous observed odometry XY projected onto tangent
sign.ell: existing median positive adjacent node spacing
sign.sigma2: population variance(ddof0) of true_node_delta - progress/ell,consecutive saved inference IDs only
sign.transition: Gaussian density sampled at integer node offsets and row-normalized over global node range;mean=progress/ell;no cutoff/floor

inheritance: OBS uses HMM0 transition;SIGN uses original emission;OBS+SIGN uses both. HMM0 and NET delegate to frozen nomad_hmm_replay.Replay.

goal_delay.primary: first MAP==goal at/after origin;delay is inference ID difference
goal_delay.censor: no MAP==goal at/after origin through log end -> right censored;exclude from primary median and print count beside median
goal_delay.negative: first MAP==goal before origin -> separate negative count,signed first-MAP minus origin delay;can overlap later censor
goal_delay.no_truth_goal: no true_node goal observed -> separate,not delay0

reporting: EVAL performance only;CAL and EVAL used run/inference counts by phase;CAL parameter/coverage metadata allowed,no CAL accuracy table
assumptions: Topomap node poses and observation-time exact odometry available in shared world frame;recorded candidate windows fixed;no missing distance synthesis
limitations: OBS product assumes conditional independence of window distances and may be overconfident
SIGN variance uses logged HMM0 MAP tangent and includes error from incorrectly localized segments
execution: Cache calibration contributions perrun;fit/save immutable model before any EVAL;resume requires same CAL fingerprint. Per-EVAL cache with input/model/protocol hash;1min progress;automatic report commit/push.
